inlines.v: LOG'GERHEAD, noun [log and head.] 1. A blockhead; a dunce; a dolt; a thick-skull. 2. A spherical mass of iron, with a long handle; used to heat tar. To fall to loggerheads, To go to loggerheads, to come to blows; to fall to fighting without weapons.
